statement: The product shall remain an independent Cybersecurity Learning and Operations Simulation Platform and shall not be represented as CARE or a production security tool.
rationale: Prevents identity and authority drift.

statement: v1 product completeness shall mean coherent secure recoverable core workflows and tested vertical slices, not complete curriculum across all Domains.
rationale: Prevents false curriculum claims.

statement: v1 shall require one local owner account with secure password handling, protected sessions, CSRF defense, and explicit sign-out.
rationale: Local deployment still requires authentication.

statement: Application permissions and simulated professional roles shall be separate models.
rationale: Scenario roles must not grant product authority.

statement: The system shall preserve immutable original source custody with digest authorization metadata and import history.
rationale: All downstream trust begins with preserved custody.

statement: Imports shall be quarantined path-safe size-limited type-validated and non-executing.
rationale: Sources and packages are untrusted.
acceptance_method: Malicious-file traversal archive and MIME tests

statement: Source segments claims and citations shall preserve stable anchors digests authority applicability conflicts and review status.
rationale: Filenames and generated labels are not authority.

statement: Canonical Knowledge Units shall remain singular and contextual reuse shall use typed relationships.
rationale: Avoids duplicated canonical truth.

statement: Published knowledge lesson enterprise baseline and scenario definition revisions shall be immutable and restoration shall publish a new revision.
rationale: Protects history and reproducibility.
acceptance_method: Mutation rejection revision and restoration tests

statement: Runtime lesson content shall use registered typed versioned blocks with allowlisted payload fields nesting size and renderer rules.
rationale: Avoids arbitrary JSON and unsafe rendering.
acceptance_method: Schema invalid-payload nesting and renderer tests

statement: The adaptive lifecycle shall support lesson micro practice Guided Simulator Lab selective Real-Lab evidence mastery and failure review with stages selected per KU.
rationale: Learning must be capability-specific rather than uniform completion.

statement: The Institutional Simulator shall be the default Guided Lab path and shall be stateful identity-aware permission-aware and policy-aware.
rationale: Provides repeatable institutional practice without mandatory real environments.
acceptance_method: Scenario positive negative state and permission tests

statement: Real-Lab Validation shall be optional recommended or required for a specific claim and never universal.
rationale: Simulation fidelity varies by claim.

statement: Every evidence record shall identify origin as SIMULATED REAL_LAB MANUAL_ASSESSMENT or SOURCE_REVIEW.
rationale: Prevents false competence claims.

statement: Reusable organizations sites networks assets identities policies controls risks findings detections procedures and related enterprise concepts shall be persistent catalogs.
rationale: Scenarios must reuse institutional truth.

statement: A Scenario Run shall use an isolated snapshot and shall never silently mutate an Enterprise Baseline.
rationale: Protects persistent enterprise truth and replay.

statement: Simulation shall produce a deterministic explanation trace from versioned baseline scenario identity permissions action rules prior state and seed.
rationale: Static output and opaque decisions do not establish practice.
acceptance_method: Repeat reset replay and trace-diff tests

statement: A visual Scenario Studio shall be the primary scenario authoring path.
rationale: Normal users must not hand-edit packages.

statement: Scenario Packages shall be portable versioned manifested representations of the same Studio model and shall import as untrusted drafts.
rationale: Supports reuse without creating a second model.
acceptance_method: Round-trip schema digest and tamper tests

statement: Mastery shall use capability-specific evidence rules and candidate states rather than a percentage-complete value.
rationale: Completion is not competence.

statement: The daily queue shall explain selection and schedule failure-specific and retention-specific review.
rationale: Adaptive actions must be inspectable.
acceptance_method: Queue rationale priority and review-trigger tests

statement: AIInteractionPort shall provide only Manual AI Bridge export manual ChatGPT Plus processing structured import validation and human review.
rationale: Current decision deliberately excludes automated AI.
acceptance_method: Architecture scan status-machine and no-network-call tests

statement: Core v1 workflows shall operate locally without public Internet.
rationale: Protects privacy and availability.

statement: The application shall be one deployable Modular Monolith with explicit module ownership and internal contracts.
rationale: Minimizes operations without losing boundaries.

statement: The preferred foundation shall be Laravel PHP Vue 3 TypeScript Inertia PostgreSQL Tailwind and WSL2 Docker Compose with exact supported versions selected and locked in Task 006.
rationale: Provides a coherent locally operable stack without stale version assumptions.
acceptance_method: Environment compatibility lockfile and version report

statement: PostgreSQL relational storage shall be primary and JSONB shall be limited to registered validated type-specific payloads.
rationale: Preserves integrity while supporting bounded variation.

statement: PostgreSQL full-text search shall be the initial search service and shall enforce authorization and provenance-aware results.
rationale: Avoids premature search infrastructure.
acceptance_method: Arabic English relevance authorization and snippet tests

statement: The initial asynchronous mechanism shall be a database-backed queue with ProcessingRun idempotency lease retry and terminal-failure state.
rationale: Makes work recoverable without a broker.
acceptance_method: Duplicate retry timeout cancellation and recovery tests

statement: Important authentication custody publication scenario evidence AI package export import backup and restore changes shall create audit records atomically.
rationale: Audit gaps undermine review truth.
acceptance_method: Audit coverage atomicity and correlation tests

statement: Portable imports and exports shall use versioned schemas safe relative paths manifests per-file SHA-256 and explicit scope.
rationale: Supports safe review reuse and transfer.
acceptance_method: Round-trip missing tamper traversal and version tests

statement: Backup and restore shall preserve database blob and revision consistency using a manifest and staged verification.
rationale: Local-first data must be recoverable.
acceptance_method: Backup restore corruption and abandoned-stage tests

statement: The implementation shall mitigate every threat recorded in SECURITY_REQUIREMENTS.tsv and preserve residual limitations.
rationale: Security must be testable and product-specific.

statement: The interface shall be Arabic-first with native RTL prose isolated LTR technical tokens and no manual string reversal.
rationale: Technical bidi content must remain readable and copyable.
acceptance_method: RTL LTR visual DOM and copy tests

statement: Principal workspaces shall support semantic HTML keyboard navigation visible focus adequate contrast and responsive desktop tablet mobile reflow.
rationale: Accessibility is a release property.
acceptance_method: Automated and manual accessibility plus viewport tests

statement: VS-001 shall traverse reviewed source publication practice simulated Windows authorization evidence mastery and failure review for CAP-D03-03-01 and KU-AD-02.
rationale: The first slice must validate the whole product lifecycle deeply.

statement: VS-001 technical publication and real-transfer claims shall remain blocked until a target Windows baseline and Microsoft Open Specifications are reviewed.
rationale: Current local evidence is not authoritative Windows truth.

statement: Tasks 006 through 010 shall follow the bounded sequence and named review gates without self-approval.
rationale: Prevents uncontrolled implementation drift.

statement: v1 shall not claim complete cybersecurity curriculum or promote all 96 provisional KU candidates to finished content.
rationale: Semantic architecture is expansion capacity not finished curriculum.

statement: The v1 roadmap shall not include microservices Kafka Kubernetes graph or search clusters Redis automated AI provider adapters local models or marketplace infrastructure.
rationale: No blocking need has been established.

statement: Displayed lesson or scenario commands shall never execute merely because they are displayed or selected.
rationale: Separates education and simulation from host compromise.
acceptance_method: No-process no-network and UI interaction tests

statement: Any development-only authentication bypass shall be off by default visible audited and impossible in a release profile.
rationale: Convenience must not create a release backdoor.

statement: Draft published imported reviewed unresolved simulated and real-lab states shall be visibly and non-color-only distinguished.
rationale: Prevents misleading workflow and evidence state.

statement: Real-execution connectors and production operational integrations shall remain outside v1.
rationale: The platform is a learning and simulation product.
